summary: Verified strategy.py Maya-persona-leak fix + new per-user grounding. Ran full backend pytest suite (107/107 passed after exporting EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var for test collection). Directly tested POST /api/strategy/plans with a fresh non-Maya seeded user ('Jordan Rivera', asset 'Weekly Woodworking Show', $480 MTD revenue) — generated plan correctly referenced the real asset name and scaled targets proportionately ($480→$720 for 30-day, $480→$1,200 for 60-day); confirmed via grep that no Maya/184k/56k/22.8k/'Ship It' strings appear in any generated plan. PATCH /api/strategy/plans/{id}/task verified working (task_progress + progress_pct updated correctly). Frontend /strategy screen tested end-to-end via Playwright: horizon selector (30/60/90), Generate plan button, live AI generation (Claude Sonnet 4.5, ~40-50s), plan render, milestone task-toggle checkbox, and Past plans history section — all working correctly with the grounded content displayed.

minor.issue: Tests read os.environ['EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL'] directly at import time, which is only present in frontend/.env, not exported in the shell running pytest by default — causes collection errors unless manually exported first. Pre-existing issue, not introduced this session, but worth a conftest.py fixture that loads frontend/.env or backend/.env fallback so `pytest tests/` works out-of-the-box without manual export.

action_items: Minor: add a conftest.py env-loader (or export instructions in tests/README) so the 4 non-strategy test files don't need EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL manually exported before running pytest tests/.
critical_code_review_comments: _build_strategy_context in strategy.py correctly mirrors server.py's _build_system_prompt pattern — queries db.assets scoped by user['user_id'], computes revenue/profit/margin from real data, and falls back gracefully to a 'no assets yet' message for brand-new users. No hardcoded persona remains.

STRATEGY_CONTEXT_TEMPLATE explicitly instructs the LLM not to invent a different business and to scale targets proportionately — verified in practice: a $480/mo user got a $720-$1,200/mo target range, not $56k.
Endpoint contracts unchanged (verified against original schema: title, summary, horizon_days, north_star, kpis, phases, leading_indicators) — no breaking changes for frontend consumers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (strategy screen generation, task toggle, history all verified)

seed_data_creation: Seeded throwaway user 'user_qa_strategy' (qa_strategy@example.com, name='Jordan Rivera') with session token 'qa-strategy-token' and one custom asset ('Weekly Woodworking Show', $480 MTD revenue) directly in MongoDB for isolated grounding verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Strategy Planner Maya-persona bug fix is fully verified working both at API level and through the actual UI — generated plans are grounded in the signed-in user's real assets/revenue and scale proportionately, with zero leakage of the old hardcoded demo persona strings. Backend regression suite is 107/107 green. Did not re-run the paid-LLM eval suite in backend/evals/ per instructions (already confirmed 4/4 by main agent).
